title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Averages
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The average age of 26 students of a class is 26 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 27 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.explain: Total age of 26 students $= 26 \times 26 = 676$. If the teacher is included, there are 27 people. Total age of 27 people $= 27 \times 27 = 729$. Age of the teacher $= 729 - 676 = 53$ years.
